changelog: Add an optional Xiaohongshu lookup. Before drafting, the Skill can read one page of the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes, so the copy rests on the platform instead of on guesswork. Optional, priced per read, and confirmed separately; a run that skips it still delivers the full copy.

en.description: Create Xiaohongshu or REDnote copy from a product, experience, topic, or audience brief. This AI Xiaohongshu copywriter produces title options, a structured note body, cover wording, relevant hashtags, and a natural comment starter for product discovery, local experiences, beauty, food, fashion, travel, and knowledge posts. It then renders a matching vertical 3:4 Xiaohongshu cover built around the chosen title, with a headline-safe composition. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
en.summary: Turn a product, experience, topic, or audience brief into Xiaohongshu title options, a readable note body, cover text, hashtags, and a natural comment starter.
en.title: Zhongcao Note Copywriter: Xiaohongshu Titles and Post Copy
